description: Read a requested KB guide or a known source section by slug. Use directly when the user requests the document itself; no preliminary graph call is required. For a general explanation use query_knowledge op=ask, not a document-reading sequence. If a needed slug is unknown, locate it with kb_search or kb_list_documents. Use view=overview for a guide summary; view=section with a returned section_anchor for a specific passage. Content defaults to 6000 characters; offset and next_offset count characters within the selected body. Continue only when the requested material is missing, not merely because has_more is true. full=True is for explicit full-document requests. A document excerpt is educational material; executable signal identities and parameters come from the runtime registry.

full.description: Explicit full content download; cannot combine with offset or max_chars.

max_chars.description: Page size, default 6000, capped at 12000 and the response budget.

offset.description: Pagination offset in the result units documented by the tool; zero starts the first page.

section_anchor.description: Exact anchor from overview or search, required only for section view.

view.description: Use overview for a brief summary and headings; section for a specific topic; content for document pages.

name: kb_get_document
